<think><details><summary>Thought Process</summary>
**Implementing file upload URL**

I'm working on the mutation finalizeUpload to also return a public URL. I need to confirm that storage.getUrl is asynchronous. Based on the Convex storage API, ctx.storage.generateUploadUrl() gives me a URL, and I can upload using fetch with the file. The response includes a JSON object with storageId. 

I should call ctx.storage.getUrl(storageId) to obtain a temporary URL. The getUrl function typically returns a URL that can expire. Notably, it generally gives a permanent URL by default, so I'm considering making an HTTP action to ensure we can serve images by ID for a stable route.
**Exploring image uploading to Convex**

The user wants to know about uploading images to Convex. The simplest way would be to use getUrl at rendering, but since the editor requires stable <img src="..."> links, that's not ideal. Instead, I might create a Next route /api/image/[id] as a proxy. 

Alternatively, I could utilize Convex's httpRouter and httpAction to serve bytes with the correct content type using ctx.storage.get. This approach would generate a stable public URL, like `https://<deployment>.convex.site/images/<storageId>`. I'll need to check if the repository has existing HTTP routes.</details></think>

<think><details><summary>Thought Process</summary>
**Patching image upload functionality**

I'm realizing we've added the `uploadImage` function but haven't utilized it. Plus, we added state that doesn't handle errors or uploading. Our current rendering logic for different field types needs a branch for images where we can include a preview, an input, and an upload button. We should handle template image upload errors at the field level, maybe keep a global error display near the control. Lastly, we need to refine the typing in our `uploadImage` function to be more consistent with expectations.
**Updating uploadImage function**

I'm updating the `uploadImage` function so we set `uploading` to false in the `finally` block. But I also realize that if an error is thrown, it needs to be caught and that error should trigger the UI to show a message. I plan to implement a `try/catch` to set the `TemplateImageUploadError` and rethrow the error. I'll also include a file input in the UI for users to select and upload images, updating sections on success. Finally, I'll ensure the renderer uses `CmsEditable` around the image for preview selection without causing issues on the actual site. Time to make these patches!</details></think>

---

### What changed

- **Home template now has an image field in content**: added `imageUrl` to the Home Hero section and render it on the homepage template (`src/lib/templates/home.tsx`).
- **Backward compatible with already-saved pages**: `coerceHomeContent` already merges section defaults; adding `imageUrl` to hero defaults means older saved pages without it safely fall back. I also added `heroImageUrl` support to the legacy flat-content coercion (`src/lib/templates/index.tsx`).
- **CMS editor supports the new field**: added a new template field type **`"image"`** and a CMS UI control that lets you paste a URL or **upload an image to Convex** (stores it and sets the field to the returned URL) (`src/app/cms/pages/[id]/page.tsx`).

### Files touched

- `src/lib/templates/types.ts`: added `TemplateFieldType` `"image"`.
- `src/lib/templates/home.tsx`: added `hero.imageUrl` field + default + render.
- `src/lib/templates/index.tsx`: added `heroImageUrl` legacy coercion mapping.
- `src/app/cms/pages/[id]/page.tsx`: added `TemplateImageField` uploader/input UI for `type: "image"` fields.

    "content": "import { mutationGeneric, queryGeneric } from \"convex/server\";\nimport { v } from \"convex/values\";\nimport { nowMs, requireSession } from \"./authUtils\";\n\nexport const generateUploadUrl = mutationGeneric({\n  args: { sessionToken: v.string() },\n  handler: async (ctx, args) =&gt; {\n    await requireSession(ctx.db, args.sessionToken);\n    return await ctx.storage.generateUploadUrl();\n  },\n});\n\nexport const finalizeUpload = mutationGeneric({\n  args: {\n    sessionToken: v.string(),\n    storageId: v.id(\"_storage\"),\n    originalFilename: v.optional(v.string()),\n    contentType: v.optional(v.string()),\n    size: v.optional(v.number()),\n  },\n  handler: async (ctx, args) =&gt; {\n    const { user } = await requireSession(ctx.db, args.sessionToken);\n\n    // Light validation (don’t be overly strict; this is a starter CMS).\n    if (args.contentType &amp;&amp; !args.contentType.startsWith(\"image/\")) {\n      throw new Error(\"Only image uploads are supported\");\n    }\n\n    const imageId = await ctx.db.insert(\"images\", {\n      storageId: args.storageId,\n      originalFilename: args.originalFilename,\n      contentType: args.contentType,\n      size: args.size,\n      uploadedBy: user._id,\n      createdAt: nowMs(),\n    });\n\n    const url = await ctx.storage.getUrl(args.storageId);\n    if (!url) throw new Error(\"Upload not found\");\n\n    return { imageId, url, storageId: args.storageId };\n  },\n});\n\nexport const list = queryGeneric({\n  args: {\n    sessionToken: v.string(),\n    limit: v.optional(v.number()),\n  },\n  handler: async (ctx, args) =&gt; {\n    const { user } = await requireSession(ctx.db, args.sessionToken);\n    const limit = Math.min(Math.max(args.limit ?? 60, 1), 200);\n\n    const docs =\n      user.role === \"admin\"\n        ? await ctx.db.query(\"images\").withIndex(\"by_createdAt\").order(\"desc\").take(limit)\n        : await ctx.db\n            .query(\"images\")\n            .withIndex(\"by_uploadedBy_createdAt\", (q) =&gt; q.eq(\"uploadedBy\", user._id))\n            .order(\"desc\")\n            .take(limit);\n\n    const out: Array&lt;{\n      imageId: string;\n      storageId: string;\n      url: string | null;\n      originalFilename?: string;\n      contentType?: string;\n      size?: number;\n      uploadedBy: string;\n      createdAt: number;\n    }&gt; = [];\n\n    for (const img of docs) {\n      const url = await ctx.storage.getUrl(img.storageId);\n      out.push({\n        imageId: img._id,\n        storageId: img.storageId,\n        url,\n        originalFilename: img.originalFilename,\n        contentType: img.contentType,\n        size: img.size,\n        uploadedBy: img.uploadedBy,\n        createdAt: img.createdAt,\n      });\n    }\n    return out;\n  },\n});\n\nexport const remove = mutationGeneric({\n  args: { sessionToken: v.string(), imageId: v.id(\"images\") },\n  handler: async (ctx, args) =&gt; {\n    const { user } = await requireSession(ctx.db, args.sessionToken);\n    const img = await ctx.db.get(args.imageId);\n    if (!img) return;\n\n    // Only admins can delete anyone’s uploads; others can delete their own.\n    if (user.role !== \"admin\" &amp;&amp; img.uploadedBy !== user._id) {\n      throw new Error(\"Forbidden\");\n    }\n\n    await ctx.db.delete(args.imageId);\n    await ctx.storage.delete(img.storageId);\n  },\n});\n\n// Public helper: turn a storageId into a URL for rendering.\nexport const getUrl = queryGeneric({\n  args: { storageId: v.id(\"_storage\") },\n  handler: async (ctx, args) =&gt; {\n    return await ctx.storage.getUrl(args.storageId);\n  },\n});\n\n",
    "languageId": "typescript"
  }
}

({ sessionToken, limit } as any) : (\"skip\" as any),\n  ) as MediaItem[] | undefined;\n\n  const generateUploadUrl = useMutation(api.images.generateUploadUrl);\n  const finalizeUpload = useMutation(api.images.finalizeUpload);\n  const removeImage = useMutation(api.images.remove);\n\n  const fileInputRef = React.useRef&lt;HTMLInputElement | null&gt;(null);\n  const [isUploading, setIsUploading] = React.useState(false);\n  const [error, setError] = React.useState&lt;string | null&gt;(null);\n\n  React.useEffect(() =&gt; {\n    if (!open) {\n      setError(null);\n      setIsUploading(false);\n    }\n  }, [open]);\n\n  React.useEffect(() =&gt; {\n    function onKeyDown(e: KeyboardEvent) {\n      if (!open) return;\n      if (e.key === \"Escape\") onClose();\n    }\n    window.addEventListener(\"keydown\", onKeyDown);\n    return () =&gt; window.removeEventListener(\"keydown\", onKeyDown);\n  }, [open, onClose]);\n\n  async function uploadFile(file: File) {\n    setError(null);\n    setIsUploading(true);\n    try {\n      const uploadUrl = (await generateUploadUrl({ sessionToken })) as unknown as string;\n      if (!uploadUrl || typeof uploadUrl !== \"string\") throw new Error(\"Failed to get upload URL\");\n\n      const resp = await fetch(uploadUrl, {\n        method: \"POST\",\n        headers: { \"Content-Type\": file.type || \"application/octet-stream\" },\n        body: file,\n      });\n      if (!resp.ok) throw new Error(&#96;Upload failed (${resp.status})&#96;);\n      const json = (await resp.json()) as unknown as { storageId?: string };\n      const storageId = typeof json?.storageId === \"string\" ? \"Uploading…\" : \"Upload\"}\n            &lt;/button&gt;\n            &lt;button\n              type=\"button\"\n              onClick={onClose}\n              className=\"inline-flex h-10 items-center justify-center rounded-full border border-zinc-200 bg-white px-4 text-sm font-medium text-zinc-900 hover:bg-zinc-100 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-950 dark:text-zinc-50 dark:hover:bg-zinc-900\"\n            &gt;\n              Close\n            &lt;/button&gt;\n          &lt;/div&gt;\n        &lt;/div&gt;\n\n        {error ? (\n          &lt;div className=\"border-b border-zinc-200 px-5 py-3 text-sm text-red-600 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:text-red-400\"&gt;\n            {error}\n          &lt;/div&gt;\n        ) : null}\n\n        &lt;div className=\"max-h-[70vh] overflow-y-auto p-5\"&gt;\n          {items === undefined ? ### Implemented: Media Library modal (browse/select/upload/delete)

- **New Convex media library API**
  - Added index for ordering: `images.by_createdAt` in `convex/schema.ts`
  - Added:
    - `images.list(sessionToken, limit?)`: returns recent images (admins see all; others see their own) + URLs
    - `images.remove(sessionToken, imageId)`: deletes the DB row and the underlying Convex stored file (admins can delete any; others only their own)
  - File: `convex/images.ts`

- **New modal UI**
  - Added `src/components/MediaLibraryModal.tsx`
  - Shows a thumbnail grid of uploads, supports:
    - **Upload more**
    - **Select** (returns the chosen image URL)
    - **Delete** (with confirm)
    - Loading + empty states, ESC + backdrop click to close

- **Wired into the image field**
  - Updated `TemplateImageField` in `src/app/cms/pages/[id]/page.tsx`:
    - Added **“Browse…”** button to open the modal
    - Selecting an image **sets the image field URL** (the input value)
    - Still supports direct URL paste and direct “Upload” button

If you want this same media library to also power the **RichTextEditor “Upload image”** button (so inserted `<img>` tags always come from the library), tell me and I’ll hook that up next.
